capacity_source_title: Regent Seven Seas Cruises Unveils Epic 150-Night 2029 World Cruise (NCLH press release)
quote: Seven Seas Mariner will become an intimate home away from home for 700 luxury travelers
notes: IDENTIFICATION (medium-high confidence, please confirm against the dock report's IMO or call sign if it has one): 'Regent Mariner' is not an official or former name. It is shorthand that cruisemapper.com uses for Seven Seas Mariner ('Although Regent Mariner debuted in 2001...'; IMO 9210139). Regent's only ship with 'Mariner' in its name is Seven Seas Mariner, and no other vessel named 'Regent Mariner' was found. The defunct Regency Cruises 'Regent' ships had no Mariner. Seven Seas Mariner sails the Caribbean in 2026-27 (Cruise Industry News, 2026-10-31) and the 2029 world cruise starts in Miami, which fits a PortMiami call. Caveat: the same dock report prints the other Regent ships with their full names, so this name may come from a different feed. Capacity: the official 700 figure is stated as travelers for that voyage without a basis. Cruise Industry News says '720-passenger vessel'. CruiseMapper's spec gives 'Passengers: 708 - 779' and its review says 'a double-occupancy capacity of about 700'. rssc.com returned 403.
